scientific_integrity: All-length proof via polynomial-module decomposition and rank-to-Jordan reconstruction. Exact computations independently check finite cases, not infinite coverage or historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: No primitive-cycle census for the invertible component; characteristic two and open-neighbor wheel updates only. Prior-art comparison cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Hub-induced Jordan anomalies and exact transient populations for parity waves on wheel graphs
